items.title: Surge in perfect scores prompts calls to include medical licensing exams in AI cheating probe
items.excerpt: Perfect scores on the medical law section of Korea's physician licensing exam rose from 20 in 2022 to 137 this year, prompting a lawmaker to call for healthcare licensing exams to be included in a government investigation into suspected AI-assisted cheating.

items.title: 27일부터 AI 가짜 의사·약사 광고 금지…위반 시 영업정지
items.excerpt: 식약처가 AI로 만든 가상의 전문가가 제품을 추천해 소비자를 오인하게 하는 광고를 금지하는 시행규칙을 정비해, 11월 27일부터 식품표시광고법·약사법·화장품법, 12월 10일부터 의료기기법 관련 규정을 시행한다. 위반 시 영업정지.

items.title: AI가 의사 대체?…"오히려 의사 책임 더 커질 것"
items.excerpt: 국회 'AI 시대 전문가성' 토론회에서 고려의대 안덕선 명예교수는 AI가 의료 현장에 깊이 들어올수록 의료 불확실성에 AI가 초래하는 불확실성까지 더해져 의사가 져야 할 책임 영역이 넓어질 것이라고 전망했다.

items.title: 뷰노 '딥카스', 中 하이난 보아오 슈퍼병원서 첫 현지 검증 돌입
items.excerpt: 뷰노가 심정지 예측 AI '딥카스'의 중국 첫 현지 검증 병원으로 하이난성 러청 의료관광 특구의 보아오 슈퍼병원을 선정, 실사용 데이터 확보와 중화권 시장 안착을 추진한다.

items.title: 대구가톨릭대의료원, AI 음성인식 의무기록 '보이스 EMR' 고도화
items.excerpt: 대구가톨릭대의료원이 2024년 영상의학과·핵의학과에 도입한 AI 음성인식 의무기록 '보이스 EMR'을 고도화해, 진료 대화에서 의학적으로 의미 있는 정보를 선별하고 의료진별 서식에 맞춰 의무기록을 자동 생성하도록 했다.

items.title: 대한민국의학한림원, 美 AAMC 연례 회의서 의료 AI 교육 사업 소개
items.excerpt: 의학한림원이 과기정통부·NIPA 지원 '의료 AI 교육 확산' 사업(K-MAINE)의 의대생 의료 AI 역량 프레임워크와 전국 정규 교육과정 확산 성과를 미국의과대학협회(AAMC) 연례 회의에서 공유했다.

items.title: Generative fundus angiography from misaligned handheld images for non-invasive screening of infantile retinal diseases
items.excerpt: A generative AI model synthesizes fundus fluorescein angiography from misaligned handheld color fundus photos of infants, aiming to give dye-free visualization of retinal vascular abnormalities for screening infantile retinal diseases, a leading cause of childhood blindness.

items.title: Deep Learning Analysis of Korotkoff Sounds for Heart Failure Detection: A Prospective Multicentre Observational Study
items.excerpt: Prospective four-centre study of 1,103 cardiovascular inpatients in China: deep learning on Korotkoff sounds recorded during routine blood pressure measurement detected heart failure with AUC 0.924 in the independent test cohort, including NYHA class I patients.

items.title: Utilizing AI Decision Support Tools in Burn Resuscitation: Comparing A Large Language Model to a Computerized Decision Support Tool
items.excerpt: Retrospective study comparing crystalloid resuscitation volume estimates from a commonly used large language model against an established computerized clinical decision support system for severe burn patients.

items.title: Artificial intelligence literacy among health-care professionals: a systematic review of reported competency needs
items.excerpt: Systematic review in The Lancet Digital Health mapping the AI literacy competencies that health-care professionals are reported to need. (Date via Crossref created; Lancet article pages are not fetchable.)

items.title: Workplace Artificial Intelligence Use in Health Care and Non-Health Care Occupations
items.excerpt: Cross-sectional study of US employees comparing the prevalence of workplace AI use among health care and non-health care workers across 11 work tasks. (Date via Crossref created.)

items.title: Who oversees digital health? Providers face a regulatory maze
items.excerpt: Federal agencies split oversight of digital health and AI tools, while states add their own rules on top; experts explain how providers can navigate both without tripping up.

items.title: Validation of Computer Vision in the Operating Room for Ambient Documentation
items.excerpt: Stanford Health Care study in JAMA Surgery validates computer-vision ambient timestamp documentation (Aimbient) across a variety of operating-room procedures, reporting human-level accuracy for automated OR documentation. (Date from Crossref created; JAMA HTML behind Cloudflare.)

items.title: AI matches radiologists on prostate cancer MRI across 22 countries
items.excerpt: The SCARLET-1 study in Radiology analyzed 22,445 prostate MRI exams from 21,252 men at 46 sites in 22 countries; the AI system matched standard-of-care radiologist readings (83%-87.9% agreement across three external datasets). Check vs 2026-10-14 AuntMinnie prostate-MRI AI item for possible same-study overlap.

items.title: Multimodal AI for bacterial vs viral upper respiratory tract infection multicentre development and internal validation
items.excerpt: A multimodal AI model fusing pharyngeal images with clinical data was developed and internally validated across multiple centres to distinguish Group A streptococcus pharyngitis from viral upper respiratory infections, aiming to guide appropriate antibiotic use.

items.title: Samjin Pharm, Ontact Health launch AI-assisted echocardiography service
items.excerpt: Samjin Pharmaceutical and Ontact Health launched SoniX EchoPilot, an AI echocardiography service that auto-classifies images, selects optimal views, performs measurements and strain analysis, and returns specialist-reviewed reports to cut clinician workload and inter-examiner variability.

items.title: 조기위암 침윤 깊이 예측까지…웨이센 '웨이메드 엔도', AI 내시경 패러다임 전환 예고
items.excerpt: KDDW 2026에서 강남세브란스병원 연구진이 웨이센 AI 내시경 '웨이메드 엔도'로 조기위암의 침윤 깊이를 예측한 연구와 실사용 임상 경험을 발표했다. 내시경 절제와 수술 중 치료 방식을 가르는 지표를 AI가 뒷받침한다는 내용이다.

items.title: FDA-Authorized AI/ML Tool for Sepsis Prediction: Development and Validation
items.excerpt: NEJM AI paper describing the development and validation of an FDA-authorized AI/ML sepsis prediction tool (Crossref created 2026-11-19; body not retrievable - verify details).

items.title: Weekly Rundown: Waystar integrates into Google Cloud's Gemini for healthcare; Oracle debuts AI agents for clinical trials
items.excerpt: Weekly health-tech brief: Oracle Life Science AI Agents for clinical-trial portfolio monitoring and planning; Amazon Connect Health adds agentic patient-access tasks (Temple Health handling thousands of verification calls weekly); Artera agentic intake; ChatGPT Health expands. Vendor roundup - low priority.

items.title: AI-assisted chest CT scan analysis of body composition at ICU admission and 6-month mortality
items.excerpt: Secondary analysis of a single-center prospective cohort of 509 ICU patients: automated AI body-composition analysis of admission chest CT, a measure rarely taken manually, was linked to 6-month survival.

items.title: Modular phantom tests AI on ovarian mass ultrasound
items.excerpt: RSNA 2026 preview: University of Twente researchers built an O-RADS-based transvaginal ultrasound phantom to enable controlled testing of computer-aided diagnosis software for ovarian masses.

items.title: 심평원, AI 활용 '고가약 사전 심사 기간 단축' 추진
items.excerpt: 건강보험심사평가원이 AI로 급여 인정 가능성이 높은 고가약 사전심사 사례를 선별해 대기시간을 줄이고, 청구 데이터로 희귀질환 의심 환자를 찾는 파운데이션 모델도 검토한다. 적용 시점은 미정.

items.title: Innovaccer integrates Grok Voice into Gravity Voice AI agents
items.excerpt: Innovaccer is adding xAI's Grok Voice to its Gravity Voice AI agents for autonomous patient engagement calls (vendor upgrade; check for measured outcomes).

items.title: Coreline Soft secures 13th FDA 510(k) clearance with aorta AI software
items.excerpt: Korea medical AI company Coreline Soft said Thursday it has received FDA 510(k) clearance for AVIEW Aorta Metrics, an AI software that measures aortic diameter. items.title: 진단만 하는 AI 넘어섰다…자율 의료 AI 에이전트, 검사·처방·입원 결정까지 수행
items.excerpt: 네이처 논문 소개: 하이델베르크대 등 연구진의 자율 의료 AI 에이전트 'MIRA'가 실제 환자 574명 기록 기반 가상 응급실에서 문진·검사·처방·입원 결정까지 수행, 311개 사례 진단 정확도 87.8%로 전문의(78.1%)를 웃돌았다. 실환자 검증은 과제.

items.title: Epic Systems defends competitive practices, promises to let AI access its records
items.excerpt: At HLTH, executives from Epic, the largest EHR vendor, defended its competitive practices and pledged to let outside AI tools access patient records held in its systems.
